summary: Presents a matrix comparing WinRM authentication options (Basic, Certificate, Kerberos, NTLM, CredSSP) by local account support, AD account support, credential delegation, and HTTP encryption.
questions: Which WinRM auth methods support domain accounts?
Which WinRM authentication options allow credential delegation?
Does NTLM encrypt WinRM traffic over HTTP?
What are my options for authenticating to Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: WinRM authentication options compared
answer_card.answer_md:
| Option | Local | AD | Delegation | HTTP encryption |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | Yes | No | No | No |
| Certificate | Yes | No | No | No |
| Kerberos | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| NTLM | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| CredSSP | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
